Mixes

Proportions are coverage on a part: how much of its visible surface each filament takes.

Filament contrast

WCAG 2 contrast between filaments, as a proxy for legibility of inlaid text, printed labels and two-colour marks. Text needs 4.5:1; marks and shapes 3:1. Same-colour embossing has no colour contrast at all: it depends on light and shadow, so it never carries a warning or a value on its own.

Physical sizes

Starting points for FDM with a 0.4 mm nozzle. Confirm each with a test print before a part ships.

physical.stroke-min0.8mmNarrowest raised or recessed stroke in text and marks: two nozzle widths.
physical.text-cap-min4mmSmallest cap height for moulded-in text read at arm’s length. Values and scales: JetBrains Mono (dotted zero).
physical.text-cap-label6mmCap height for a label that must be read without picking the part up (warnings, the speed scale).
physical.emboss-depth0.6mmRaised text and marks: at least three 0.2 mm layers.
physical.deboss-depth0.6mmRecessed text: deep enough to hold an inlay or paint fill.
physical.inlay-depth0.4mmA contrasting-filament inlay (two layers at 0.2 mm), flush with the face.
physical.edge-band1.2mmThe dark band that separates orange from light gray on a part, so the two never meet by hue alone.
physical.label-margin3mmClear margin around printed labels and moulded text: the physical safe margin (nothing clipped by a chamfer or fillet).
